data.variablesTransform:
{
  "create": {
    "sandbox": $state.context.parameters.sandbox,
    "integratedCarrierRequestTypeId": $state.context.parameters.integratedCarrierRequestTypeId,
    "integratedCarrierShipmentId": $state.context.parameters.integratedCarrierShipmentId,
    "connectionId": $state.context.request.connectionId,
    "request": $state.context.request,
    "response": response,
    "rawRequest": raw.request,
    "rawResponse": raw.response,
    "errors": errors,
    "error": error or $not($isNilOrEmpty(errors))
  }
}
data.mutation:
mutation CreateIntegratedCarrierRequest($create: IntegratedCarrierRequestCreateInput!) {
  createIntegratedCarrierRequest(payload: { create: $create }) {
    id
    sandbox
    integratedCarrierRequestTypeId
    integratedCarrierShipmentId
    connectionId
    request
    response
    rawRequest
    rawResponse
    errors
    error
  }
}

data.transform: $not($state.context.result.error)
